images.filename: Grace Darling Memorial at Bamborough Church.jpg
images.caption: Grace Darling's Memorial at Bamburgh Church, Northumberland, England. This is not her grave which is in a humble family vault about 20 yards to the east. The memorial was paid for by public subscription and erected shortly after her death in 1842.  Placed, at the request of local seamen, so as to be clearly visible from the sea.
images.alt: Grace Darling's Memorial at Bamburgh Church, Northumberland, England. This is not her grave which is in a humble family vault about 20 yards to the east. The memorial was paid for by public subscription and erected shortly after her death in 1842.  Placed, at the request of local seamen, so as to be clearly visible from the sea.
